definitions.explanation: Armed conflict or fighting between opposing forces. Refers to actual military engagement or, by extension, any intense confrontation or struggle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{戦闘|せんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
{戦闘|せんとう}{機|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上空|じょうくう}→上空：03080_joukuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}んで→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧いった。
{両軍|りょうぐん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{戦闘|せんとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三日間|みっかかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたり、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}→犠牲者：18769_giseisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The fighting between the two armies lasted three days, producing many casualties.

notes:
{戦闘|せんとう} specifically refers to armed fighting or military engagement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦闘|せんとう}{機|き}: fighter aircraft
- {戦闘|せんとう}{員|いん}: combatant
- {戦闘|せんとう}{力|りょく}: fighting power, combat strength
- {戦闘|せんとう}⟦{態勢|たいせい}→態勢：12937_taisei⟧: combat readiness
- {戦闘|せんとう}⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧: combat zone
- {戦闘|せんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開始|かいし}する→開始する：26826_kaishisuru⟧: to commence fighting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {戦闘|せんとう}: combat, fighting (specific military engagement)
- ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧: war (broader, a state of armed conflict between nations)
- ⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧: battle, fight (more general, includes non-military conflicts)
- ⟦{交戦|こうせん}→交戦：11724_kousen⟧: engagement, exchange of fire (formal military term)
- ⟦{合戦|かっせん}→合戦：12056_kassen⟧: battle (historical, used for premodern battles)
